heads.t: 不能再用AI搶機票！美聯航開第一槍封殺 機器人代訂3風險曝 隨著人工智慧（AI）技術快速發展，越來越多人開始使用AI助理搜尋便宜機票、規劃旅遊行程，甚至直接代替自己完成訂票。不過，美國聯合航空（United Airlines）11日宣布，將禁止未經授權的第三方AI代理程式（AI agents）透過旗下訂票系統替旅客購買機票，理由包括個人資料外洩、誤購機票，以及可能違反航空安全法規。值得注意的是，AI仍可協助旅客查詢聯航航班與票價，但無法直接在聯航網站完成交易。 6 分鐘前｜國際 不能再用AI搶機票！美聯航開第一槍封殺 機器人代訂3風險曝 6 分鐘前｜國際
heads.en: The U.S.A.'s first shot to kill a robot, three risks, and with the rapid development of AI technology, more and more people are using AI's assistant to search for cheap tickets, plan tours, and even make their own reservations. However, U.S. United Airlines announced on 11 November that it would prohibit unauthorized third-party AI agents from buying tickets for passengers through the flag-based booking system, for reasons including personal data leaks, mispurchase tickets, and possible violations of aviation security laws. It is worth noting that AI can still assist passengers in checking United flights and fares, but it is not possible to complete transactions directly on the United Nations website. Six minutes ago, I couldn't get an AI ticket! U.S.A.'s first shot was fired.
